opening.text: Ashley Monroe, the charming and influential lobbyist, finds you in a quieter room at the fundraiser.
opening.speaker: narrator

segments.speaker: ashley
segments.text: Senator, I represent some clients who are very interested in the Education Reform Bill. I'd like to discuss how we might work together.

choices.text: "I'm listening. What do you have in mind?"
"I make my decisions based on policy, not lobbying."
"This seems inappropriate. We should talk publicly."

segments.speaker: ashley
segments.text: She smiles. "My clients are prepared to be... generous... to those who see things their way. Let's just say your campaign could benefit."

choices.text: "I can't accept that kind of support."
"Tell me more about your clients' position."

segments.speaker: ashley
segments.text: "Think about it, Senator. My clients have long memories, and they reward their friends." She hands you a card and glides away, leaving you to ponder her offer.

consequences.accepted_offer: Ashley's clients will support your campaign (but Risk increases)
consequences.refused_offer: Ashley may work against you (but Risk decreases)
consequences.high_attraction: Ashley may pursue personal relationship (complicated dynamic)
